question.text: Table 3.2 of Chapter 3 lists the differentiators that FPEs and NPOs must disclose in the offer document. Which of the following is NOT a named differentiator in Table 3.2?

explanation.text: The Logic: Table 3.2 lists 11 differentiators: Vision, Target Segment, Strategy, Governance, Management, Operations, Finance, Compliance, Credibility, Social Impact, Risks. 'Investor Grievance Mechanism' is a separate LODR disclosure (Main Board Reg 13) but is NOT among the 11 SSE differentiators. The other three options are all directly listed. The Trap: Option C is a very plausible distractor because investor grievance is standard issuer disclosure for Main Board. But the SSE Framework does not elevate it to differentiator status — that job is subsumed under Governance & Compliance. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/III-C (Compliance) tests investor-grievance mechanisms under LODR Reg 13/46. XV (RA) reads grievance disclosures. This trap specifically targets candidates coming from a Compliance background. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Keep a laminated index card of the 11 differentiators in your SIA field kit. In an offer-document review, flip through the draft and tick each differentiator as you find its content. Missing row = material disclosure gap = adverse assurance.
